name: Ding Yanqian, PhD
quote: Jasmine has an exceptional way of guiding through deep reflection with gentleness, precision, and curiosity. She asks the kind of questions that go straight to the heart of things \[…]. Through our work, I've gained clarity about my values, my direction, and how to reconnect with myself when I feel lost. \[…] Her coaching doesn't just address career choices; it reaches much deeper, connecting mind, heart, and body in a way that makes change truly sustainable. \[…] The insights and framework I built with her will stay with me far beyond this coaching journey.
